name: lease-status
description: Active Membrane component lease: installation id, release generation, data-root digest, validity window, and lease status. The resource is bounded to the caller's `lease.read` grant; reads outside that grant return a typed rejection with no content leak.
authorityNotes: Reads return the active lease only. The lease cannot be used to widen authority beyond `lease.read`; a caller without the grant receives a typed `resource_access_denied` rejection and the lease body is never serialized into the response.

error.message: resources/read requires one of the grants in accessGrants: [lease.read]; caller presented [protocol.read]
